obligation: Stationary continuous-path source realization, tightness and joint measurable drift/martingale/bracket transport
source: Fixed-lattice radius-two SU2; kappa>0,0<=R<9/64,m=kappa*(1/2-3R),fixed real smooth local gauge-invariant U with norm<=delta<=m/8; rho_U=psi_U^2 nu

constructor.realization: The actual full-support weighted gradient form is regular, strongly local and conservative; its diffusion realization started in rho_U has the previously identified Feller finite-dimensional laws
constructor.weak_martingale: For real cylinder f, M^f_t=f(X_t)-f(X_0)-integral_0^t (-T f)(X_s)ds is a continuous true stationary-law martingale
constructor.uniform_geometry: L=M(U)/m,B=kappa*(3/2+4R+2L),Q=2kappa; embedding-coordinate fourth increment moment<=8B^4 h^4+96kappa^2 h^2
constructor.link_moment: For h<=S, E d_SU2(X_i(t),X_i(s))^4<=16*(11/7)^4*(8B^4 S^2+96kappa^2)*h^2 uniformly in source volume and link
constructor.path_transport: Coordinate tightness plus countable-product compactness and actual finite-time words gives weak laws on C([0,S],X)
constructor.measurable_drift_transport: Common continuous recovery b_n and stationarity give E sup_t|integral_0^t((-T_j f)-b_n)(X_s)ds|^2<=S^2*norm((-T_j f)-b_n)^2_(rho_j)
constructor.joint_readers: Finite families of actual drift integrals, martingales and brackets transport jointly with paths; null-set versions are used only in stationary laws
constructor.symmetry: Stationary, reversible and gauge equivariant before quotient

subnet.next_acceptance: Construct the actual finite-horizon original-to-tilted stationary path density, endpoint/action normalization, weak martingale/Girsanov interpretation and source entropy rate, with thermodynamic transport. Do not assert an infinite-horizon density or physical-clock calibration.
